messages:
mira: Quick design review — on-prem setup wizard network step. I pushed a small change to probe timings and the gateway-timeout fallback copy in the Figma mock: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/onprem-wizard. Can folks scan for keyboard focus flow, announcements for screen readers, and microcopy?
jamal: Looked at the mock. Timing improvements feel better, but keyboard focus jumps when a probe finishes and the status pills reorder. If you tab through, focus ends up on the 'Fix' CTA instead of staying on the step header.
sophia: Good catch. For SRs we want updates announced but not steal focus. Suggest using role="status" + aria-live="polite" for the probe summary, and avoid auto-focus except for critical failures. Microcopy: replace "If gateway times out, try again later." with "Connection timed out — try these steps" + a short list.
alex: Repro'd the focus jump — it's caused by reordering the DOM when we update results. Using stable keys (host.id) prevents node replacement. Also avoid focusing elements on mount; instead focus a hidden announcer or the summary region.
riley: UX idea: add a small inline "Why this matters" tooltip next to the status to explain egress/SSH checks. For keyboard, when a probe fails we could move focus to the summary (tabindex="-1" then .focus()), but that conflicts with non-interruptive SR flows — we should prototype both.
jamal: Quick code snippet for the announcer: ```js // accessible announcer element with polite updates const announcer = document.getElementById('probe-announcer') || (() => { const el = document.createElement('div'); el.id = 'probe-announcer'; el.setAttribute('role', 'status'); el.setAttribute('aria-live', 'polite'); el.style.position = 'absolute'; el.style.left = '-9999px'; document.body.appendChild(el); return el; })(); function announce(text){ announcer.textContent = text; } ```
mira: Microcopy nits: current CTA label "Retry probe" -> change to "Retry network check". Rename small CTA "Fix" to "Open troubleshooting guide" so it's clearer. Also change fallback line to the bulleted suggestions sophia mentioned.
sophia: For a11y testing I'll run NVDA + Chrome + keyboard-only flows on Thursday. I'll check that the announcer is read and that focus isn't lost. Also check color contrast on status pills (current yellow on light background is borderline).
alex: On infra side, when upstream returns 504 we should surface a suggested fallback (e.g., fall back to shorter probe, or suggest increasing timeout). I'll draft a short RFC to propose: capture 504 -> show "Gateway timed out — try increasing timeout or use dedicated region".
jamal: Small CSS note: the status pill transition causes layout shift when width changes between icons/text. I'll set a min-width and use opacity transitions to avoid reflow. Pushing a patch to the preview branch now.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: preview build for branch onprem-probe-fixes is live: https://preview.redwood.com/branches/onprem-probe-fixes — includes the announcer + stable keys + CSS patch. Please smoke test.
jamal: Loaded preview. Announcer element present and aria-live reads updates. Found one keyboard issue: after a failing probe the focus order is still header -> status -> fix CTA, but we want focus to remain or move to the status summary. I'll PR a small change to call summaryEl.focus() when status transitions to failed and only if the user is keyboard-active.
riley: Sounds good. I'll update the flow spec and add the tooltip content. Also will check copy in-context in the mock.
mira: Action items: jamal to implement announcer + stable keys + focus tweak; riley to update tooltip copy and keyboard-flow spec; sophia to run a11y pass; alex to file RFC for 504 fallback wording; I'll update Figma microcopy. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
mira: Closing this thread — will reopen if the a11y pass finds regressions.
